title: Grandparent scam: "Danny" is in jail and needs gift cards

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: I have a bad cold. Grandma, I'm in trouble. I was in a car accident and the police arrested me.

lines.speaker: senior
lines.text: Oh no! Are you hurt? Let me call your mother.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: No, please don't tell Mom, she'll be so mad. I just need two thousand dollars for bail today.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: My lawyer says the fastest way is gift cards. Can you go to the store, buy them, and read me the numbers on the back?

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Yes, it has to be today or I stay in jail. And please, keep this between us.
